sources.games: 741 league games since 7.40 (7.41 alone had under 300) (data/heroes/item_stats), win 47.8%. Reproduce: python scripts/hero_item_stats.py morphling.
sources.items: Valve /datafeed/itemdata, 7.41f: Monkey King Bar, Silver Edge, Daedalus.

rules.name: Monkey King Bar

reason.en: {enemy} dodges attacks: with {item} most of your attacks go through the evasion
reason.uk: {enemy} ухиляється від атак: з {item} більшість ваших атак пробиває ухилення

rules.basis: Monkey King Bar pierces evasion on 80% of attacks, nothing to cast. High-rank Morphling players against Phantom Assassin or Windranger: 19% of 64 games against them (3% otherwise), won 67% against 42%.

rules.name: Silver Edge

reason.en: {enemy} relies on {spell}: the hit out of the invisibility of {item} turns it off for 5 seconds
reason.uk: {enemy} тримається на здатності {spell}: удар із невидимості {item} вимикає її на 5 секунд

rules.basis: Valve 7.41f: Shadow Walk, the attack that ends the invisibility disables the target's passive abilities for 5 s, +300 physical damage and caps its movement speed at 200. High-rank Morphling players against Bristleback, Spectre or Huskar: 17% of 47 games against them (3% otherwise), won 62% against 54%.

build_basis: Assembled items bought in 25%+ of the won games, by median minute: magic_wand 95% (-2), power_treads 100% (6), ring_of_basilius 89% (8), buckler 88% (9), vladmir 88% (10), yasha 98% (14), manta 98% (18), dragon_lance 38% (21), butterfly 76% (25), black_king_bar 43% (30), skadi 24% (30), lesser_crit 29% (31), greater_crit 24% (34), aghanims_shard 21% (35).

tempo.basis: Gold lines where the hero wins 85.0%+: 25:00 16500 (78 games, 88.5%), 30:00 20500 (93 games, 86.0%); net worth ~0.96 of that gold.

reason.en: Your net worth is {net_worth}, well ahead for this minute: {item} on the tempo build comes before the counters, then take the Aegis and push for the throne
reason.uk: Ваш нетворс — {net_worth}, набагато більше звичайного для цієї хвилини: спершу {item} з темпової збірки, потім заберіть Aegis і йдіть на трон

suppress.illusions: Morphling turns agility into his attack and Adaptive Strike; Manta Style is in his build. High-rank Morphling players do not buy Maelstrom against illusion heroes (49 games: it is not among the items they buy more often there).

skills.basis: 741 games: maxed morphling_waveform > morphling_morph_agi > morphling_adaptive_strike_agi 176 (win 63.1%), morphling_waveform > morphling_adaptive_strike_agi > morphling_morph_agi 164 (win 53.0%), morphling_waveform > morphling_adaptive_strike_agi 142 (win 52.1%); talents 10: Morph Duration 403/740 (47.9%), +15% Magic Resistance 337/740 (47.8%); 15: Waveform Range 633/680 (52.4%), +75 Attack Range 47/680 (44.7%); 20: +15 Agility 434/451 (62.2%), Adaptive Strike Cooldown 17/451 (64.7%); 25: Waveform Cooldown 32/37 (84.4%), +35 Strength 5/37 (60.0%).
